title: The road SOL cuts never fired in play: on this maze of one-cell corridors the cheapest rock-weighted walk crosses rock once or twice in two hundred cells, so the rule found a rock at 2% of the route and only at the arena's rim where the drive out is over; second version: the shortcut worth `saves` cells within `ahead` hops, else the wall beside the route (`flank`), measured at 99% of the route; and the unseated beam never burned at all: the station's hands only hold with a seat, so the road gets an arsenal road target held like an automated aim, and each ask lays the pass afresh over its cell; --arena-road drives the beacon phase in stages and watches SOL ask, lay, burn and release
context: The owner away (2026-10-16): a reproduction pass over the road (2026-10-16-rotor-back-to-manual-lemon-first-wave-enormous-arena-sol-road: every 7 s the first rock within 7 cells on the hull's cheapest walk to the arena, a rock cell costing 4, burned by a SOL pass laid over it). --arena shortcuts the drive out with arenaNow(), so the road had never run under a suite. A new step --arena-road holds the beacon phase and watches state().boss.road and state().laser: in 59 s of game clock with the hull at the base nothing fired (asks 1, cell -1); with the hull put down 12 cells along the open route the ask came every 7 s and answered -1 each time (SOL online, the hooks wired). Measured offline on the shipped planet (the bake, buildStoryPlanet; tools/probes/road-measure.mjs and road-rules-sweep.mjs): the open route from the base's hull cell to the arena is 282 cells through corridors with 2.8 open neighbours a cell on average (a four-neighbour lattice, 60% rock); the cheapest rock-weighted walk from the base crosses 2 rock cells in 214, the first at its twelfth step, and from 12, 30, 60 and 120 cells out crosses one rock, far down the walk; the rule as built fires at 6 of 282 route cells (2%), all six at the arena's rim (route index 265 on), where hullNearArena suppresses it; rockCost 2 or 3 and ahead 12 change nothing (3%); ahead 20 reaches 9%. A detour in this maze is seldom four cells longer than the wall between two corridors is thick, so breaking rock almost never wins the walk, and when it does the rock is far beyond the look-ahead. Second finding, from the same step once the road asked: SOL took the cell (laid true, the pass overhead) and the beam never burned (state().laser.burning false through the hold, rocks 0), at the base too. td-tab's solRoad drove the beam through laser-station aimCell, the harness's hands (arsenal.steer/hold), and src/fx/laser-arsenal.js counts a held hand only with a seat (`held = (seated && (input.held || testHeld)) || (aim && safe)`): with nobody seated and SOL's automation off, nothing held the beam. And a pass already overhead was reused, so a second road cell had to be reached by the beam's slew (16 m/s) from the last contact, farther than its 2.5 s hold allows. Third finding: with the beam held, a flank rock beside the hull's own cell was asked for, SOL took it and the beam still did not burn: the unsafe guard (LASER_AUTO.safeMetres 25 m past the beam's 6 m radius, the hull a friend) refused a contact within three cells of the hull, so the road's nearest rocks could never be burned by design. Fourth, with the hull four cells off: SOL took a flank rock 300 m out and the beam still did not burn; the arsenal's verdict and its nearest-friend distance put in the probe's rows (state().laser.held, friendM) read 10.7 m: a structure of ours (a cargo lander beside the route) inside the guard's margin, not the hull.
outcome: src/domain/arena.js roadAhead, second version: every open cell within `ahead` hops of the hull, every rock beside one of them crossed through up to `through` rock cells to open ground on the far side, the saving on the open walk to the arena (the hull's own open distance less the hops to the rock, the rocks crossed and the far side's distance); the best saving of at least `saves` cells is the rock; none worth it and `flank` on, the first rock bordering the open route within `ahead` cells of the hull, the wall beside the corridor ahead. `field` (the open-ground distance to the arena from every cell) may be handed in; td-tab's roadNext hands the lure's story.arenaField and solRoad drops that cache when a burn's hold is released (a burned cell is open ground now). ARENA.road: { every 7, ahead 12, burn 2.5, saves 4, through 2, flank true, clear 4, overhead 45, energy 40, radius 6, slew 16 } (rockCost gone). Measured on the shipped planet along the same route: fires at 278 of 282 cells (99%), 12 of them shortcuts, all near the base where the clearing's rim is a cut worth 35 to 67 cells; worst ask 8.7 ms with the field handed in, once every 7 s. test/arena.mjs: the shortcut through two rocks worth eight cells, not worth nine, one rock deep finds no far side, the flank names the wall beside the route and nothing past the look-ahead, a handed field agrees, the detour cell's cut back worth six. Browser step --arena-road: the beacon phase, SOL online, the hooks wired, the hull put down 12, 30 and 60 cells along the open route; at each stage the ask within 7 s, SOL takes the cell (a pass laid when none is overhead, the beam held), rock burned, the hold released within burn + 3 s; a stage may answer no rock in reach, one stage must cut; Isao's arena_road once. The flank is a knob (ARENA.road.flank) for the owner: off, SOL cuts only shortcuts, which on this maze means a few burns leaving the base and silence after. The beam: src/fx/laser-arsenal.js gains a road target (`road(p)`; state().road), taken by the frame as an automated aim is (held and aimed while nobody sits, the seat's own hands win, the unsafe guard over the hull and our buildings with the friends read at the ask, since the automation's refresh never runs with it off); laser-station aimCell(ci, on) sets and clears it (the harness's steer/hold untouched). td-tab's solRoad lays the pass afresh over every road cell (passOver on an overhead pass lifts and re-lays, the contact on the point), so the beam starts on the rock instead of slewing to it. `clear` (4 cells by the chord; td-tab hands the rule a `far(cell)` test over the centers, since hops are no measure round a bend): no rock that close to the hull is asked for, shortcut or flank, because the beam keeps its safe distance from a friend and would never burn it; measured with it, 275 of 282 route cells (98%), 12 shortcuts, worst ask under a millisecond with the field handed in. The rule's `far` also asks the arsenal whether the beam would burn there at all (laser-arsenal safeAt: the unsafe guard's own measure over the friends, the hull, our buildings, the walls, the towers and the heart, read afresh at most twice a second; laser-station roadSafe), so a rock beside a lander or a wall is never the road's choice.
alternatives: Lower rockCost and raise ahead on the first rule: measured, 3% at rockCost 2, 9% at ahead 20, and the walk's rock is far beyond any look-ahead a 7 s cadence can use.
Shortcuts only, no flank: fires at 4% (ahead 12, saves 4), all leaving the base; the owner asked for SOL shooting ahead 'here and there to open the maze' along the whole drive.
Burn the nearest rock to the hull regardless of the route: opens walls behind and beside the hull as often as ahead; the flank follows the route down the field so the cut is ahead.
Hold the harness hands unseated (testHeld without the seat): the hands are the harness's and the suites rely on them doing nothing in play; a named road target keeps the two apart.

Keep one pass and wait for the slew: 16 m/s against targets 70-120 m apart every 7 s never arrives inside the 2.5 s hold; a longer hold keeps SOL busy and the first version's silence stays in the trace.
evidence: --arena-road (first version): 59.4 s of game clock at the beacon, said false, a pass laid false, rocks burned 0; at 12 cells out: asks every 7 s, cell -1 each time, SOL online, wired true
tools/probes/road-rules-sweep.mjs and road-measure.mjs on the shipped bake: first rule 6 of 282 (2%), all at route index 265+; second rule 278 of 282 (99%), 12 shortcuts

test/arena.mjs; npm test 270; npm run check; --arena-road green: the beacon's own ask burns the clearing's rim (cell 1086, 3 rocks), 12 and 30 cells out nothing in reach the beam may burn (the clearing, a lander beside the route), 60 cells out the ask at 6.6 s, SOL takes cell 8311, 2 rocks burned, the hold released at 2.5 s; --arena, --laser-game, --colony and --canyon-again green with the arsenal's road target
--arena-road rows at stage 30 before this: road true, held false, friendM 10.7 m, burning false through two asks of cell 51733
